summary_responses.subtopic: Federal Credit Union Chartering & Associational Common Bond Rules
summary_responses.response: The National Credit Union Administration (NCUA) has issued a final rule to amend the criteria for determining associational common bonds for federal credit unions. The primary change ensures that requiring members to purchase a good, product, or service as a condition of membership will no longer automatically disqualify a group from being a recognized association. While the NCUA maintains its policy that associations based *primarily* on a client-customer relationship are ineligible, it will now use a multifaceted approach to determine if such a relationship is merely incidental. To increase transparency, the final rule includes detailed criteria and examples of how the NCUA assesses these relationships and simplifies the review process for pre-approved groups. This rule, which aims to enhance consumer access to affordable financial services, becomes effective on January 4, 2027.

summary_responses.subtopic: Aerospace Rotorcraft Structural Engineering & FAA Airworthiness Directives
summary_responses.response: The FAA has issued a notice of proposed rulemaking to adopt a new airworthiness directive for several Airbus Helicopters Deutschland GmbH Model EC135 and EC635 helicopters. summary_responses.subtopic: National Park Administration, Conservation & Multi-Use Trail Regulation
summary_responses.response: The National Park Service (NPS) has issued a final rule to amend special regulations for Mammoth Cave National Park, effective December 21, 2026. To protect the environment, the NPS will use sustainable trail techniques and conduct field surveys to minimize impacts on natural and cultural resources.
